header.title: Card
header.description: Container with header, body and footer to group related content. Build it with props (`title`, `subtitle`, `extra`, `footer`) or with the `Card.Header`, `Card.Body` and `Card.Footer` slots. Use `bordered` and `shadow` to choose between outline and elevation.

common.title: Project overview
common.subtitle: Updated 2 hours ago
common.body: Track delivery, owners and remaining work for this workspace. Cards group related content without becoming a page layout.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the card and its code.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `title` and `subtitle` build the header, `extra` adds actions on the right and `footer` the footer. `children` goes in the body. By default it has a border, no shadow, size `md` and radius `md`.

expandable.title: Expandable
expandable.description: `expandable` adds a button that collapses the body, footer and `media` with a height animation. Clicking the header also toggles it. `defaultExpanded={false}` starts it closed.

texts.text: Click the header or the chevron to hide and show the content.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `expanded` and `onExpandedChange` you drive the state from outside. Collapsed content stays in the DOM and can be reached with Tab, so the example uses slots and passes `inert` to `Card.Body` and `Card.Footer` while closed.

elevated.title: Elevated
elevated.description: `bordered={false}` with `shadow="md"` removes the border and relies on shadow only. Useful when the card sits on a busy background.

texts.title: Elevated card
texts.subtitle: No border, with shadow
texts.text: The shadow separates the card from the background without a border.

borderShadow.title: Border and shadow
borderShadow.description: Border and shadow can be combined for extra lift.

texts.title: Outlined and raised
texts.subtitle: Both treatments together
texts.text: Cards have a border by default. Add shadow when the surface needs to stand out.

customHeader.title: Custom header
customHeader.description: `header`, `title`, `subtitle` and `extra` accept any React node, not only text. Pass your component to `header`, or as a child of `Card.Header`, when the header isn't a title plus subtitle.

texts.name: Ana López
texts.text: The author goes in the header and the actions on the side.
texts.compoundText: Same idea with slots: children of Card.Header replace the title block.

compound.title: Slots
compound.description: `Card.Header`, `Card.Body` and `Card.Footer` keep the markup explicit. If every child is a slot, the card doesn't wrap them in another body.

texts.title: Workspace
texts.subtitle: Personal plan
texts.text: Slots are useful when the header or footer hold more than a title and buttons.

media.title: With media
media.description: `media` places an image, map or any block above the header. If the image carries information, give it an `alt`; if it's decorative, use `alt=""` or `aria-hidden`.

texts.title: Cover
texts.subtitle: The image sits above the header
texts.text: The container spans the full width and clips the overflow.
texts.alt: Gem-org banner with the tagline: build your react based app with gem-org system

rounded.title: Rounded
rounded.description: `rounded` rounds more than `radius`: `true` uses `--gem-radius-2xl`, a number is a percentage and a string is any CSS length.

texts.text: The radius also clips the image and the section edges.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: `radius` uses the `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg` tokens when `rounded` is off.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` adjusts section padding and title size: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`.

texts.lg: Roomier sections for highlights or empty states.

shadows.title: Shadows
shadows.description: `shadow` accepts `none` (default), `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg` or `xl`. In the example, all but `none` are borderless.

heading.title: Heading level
heading.description: `title` always renders as `<h3>`. If that doesn't fit the page hierarchy, pass your own heading in `header` with the right level.

texts.title: Recent activity
texts.subtitle: Last 7 days
texts.text: This title is an h4 because the section containing it uses h3.

list.title: Card list
list.description: For a collection, wrap the cards in `<ul>` and `<li>` so the count is announced. Each button includes the plan name so there aren't several identical "Choose" buttons.

plans.name: Basic
plans.text: To get started on your own.

header.title: Card API
header.description: API reference for the React Card component: props, slots, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. Slots live on `Card.Header`, `Card.Body` and `Card.Footer`, and are also exported on their own.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Card accepts <article> attributes except title, and they go to the root along with id, className and style. Card.Header renders a <header>, Card.Body a <div> and Card.Footer a <footer>, each accepting its element's attributes. classNames only applies root, media, header, body and footer: title, subtitle and extra are in the type but ignored.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.article: The root is an <article>. If the card isn't standalone content, pass another role or wrap it in a list.
a11y.heading: title always renders as <h3>. For another level, pass your own heading in header.
a11y.toggle: With expandable, the chevron button has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the content.
a11y.labels: The button name is fixed in English ("Collapse" and "Expand") and there's no prop to change it.
a11y.collapsed: Collapsed content is only hidden visually: it stays in the DOM and can be focused. Use slots in controlled mode and pass inert to Card.Body and Card.Footer while closed.
a11y.header: Clicking the header also toggles, but clicks on buttons, links and fields are ignored. Keyboard users use the chevron button.
a11y.media: media adds no alternative text: pass it on your image, or alt="" if decorative.
a11y.motion: With prefers-reduced-motion the chevron and height animations are removed.

rules.roundedCustom: Applied when `rounded` is a number or string. Uses `--gem-card-radius`.
rules.headerSolo: Applied to the header without a subtitle. Centers content vertically.
rules.heading: Title and subtitle wrapper.

Subtitle (`

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Card has a single variable of its own. Colors and spacing come from tokens and classes, so to change them use `.gem-card.your-class` plus a `[data-theme="dark"]` variant.

items.--gem-card-radius: Radius when `rounded` is a number or string. Set inline from the prop.

items.--gem-palette-neutral-{50|300|500|600}: Text, subtitle, border and separators in dark theme.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.title: Header title, as `<h3>`. Accepts a node.
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header, such as buttons or a menu.
items.header: Custom header content. Combines with `title`, `subtitle` and `extra`, or goes alone.
items.media: Image or block above the header.
items.children: Body content. If every child is a slot, they render as is.
items.bordered: Draws a 1.5px border. With `false`, combine it with `shadow`.
items.rounded: Extra rounding: `true` uses `2xl`, a number is a percentage and a string is a CSS length.
items.expandable: The header toggles body, footer and `media` with an animation.
items.classNames: Classes per part: `root`, `media`, `header`, `body` and `footer`. `title`, `subtitle` and `extra` are ignored.
items.onExpandedChange: Called when the card expands or collapses.

items.title: Title, as `<h3>`.
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header.
items.disclose: Extra control next to `extra`. With `expandable`, the card adds the chevron here.
items.children: Custom content. Goes after the title block.

sections.title: Card.Body and Card.Footer
sections.description: Body and footer slots. No props of their own.

items.footer: A `<footer>` with that element's attributes. Aligns content to the end.
